name: Sheep Seeker
description:
About This Game

You’re not a shepherd—you’re an athlete! Team up with a friend or ride solo and speed through dynamic, fast-paced levels, herding sheep in a futuristic medieval competition. Explode, Teleport, Warp to enhance your parkour skills and outmaneuver the flock. Compete for the top spot on the global leaderboard—because in this world, catching sheep is the ultimate test of speed and skill!

Features:

COOP RACE

  • You and your friends have been handpicked to compete in the prestigious Sheep Seeker World Tournament, where only the best can seek out the hidden sheep across dynamic levels.

SOLO GAMEMODE

  • You can also play solo and compete against players from around the world!

UNIQUE LOADOUTS

  • Before each run, craft your strategy and select your unique loadout to maximize your performance.

A LEADERBOARD

  • Improve your times with smart strategies and shortcuts to race to the top of the global leaderboards.
short_desc: Sheep Seeker is a fast-paced, 3D platformer where you race through dynamic levels to catch every sheep as fast as possible with a friend or solo. Unlock unique abilities to Run, Jump, Explode, and Warp to compete for the top spot on the global Sheep Seeker leaderboard!
developers: Isaac MENARD, Luna GARCIN, Alexander KIRK, Séverin RICHARD, Matthieu FARROW, François HANUS, Quentin EUNG, Mattéo GLAIRON-MONDET, Lucas RENARD, Céline TRUONG
publishers: Isaac MENARD, Luna GARCIN, Alexander KIRK, Séverin RICHARD, Matthieu FARROW, François HANUS, Quentin EUNG, Mattéo GLAIRON-MONDET, Lucas RENARD, Céline TRUONG
